scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && cd frontend && npm run format
scripts.check: npm run frontend:check && npm run backend:check
scripts.dev: export FRONTEND_PORT=${FRONTEND_PORT:-$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js frontend)} && export BACKEND_PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js backend)} && concurrently "npm run backend:dev:watch" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.test:e2e:headed: node scripts/e2e-env-check.js && E2E_HEADED=true npx playwright test --project=setup --project=${E2E_BROWSER:-chromium}
scripts.test:e2e:demos: node scripts/e2e-env-check.js --demos && E2E_HEADED=true npx playwright test --project=demos
scripts.test:e2e:health: node scripts/e2e-env-check.js && npx playwright test --project=setup --project=${E2E_BROWSER:-chromium} health-check
scripts.backend:dev: BACKEND_PORT=$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js backend) npm run backend:dev:watch
scripts.backend:dev:watch: RUST_ENV=development CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 SQLX_OFFLINE=1 DISABLE_WORKTREE_ORPHAN_CLEANUP=1 RUST_LOG=debug cargo watch --env DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-sqlite://dev_assets/db.sqlite} -w crates -x 'run --bin server'
scripts.app:build: npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build && npm run tauri:build
